transcript: Speaker A: If you don't have enough hours in the day, it's because you're not using your time wisely. Talking is four times faster than typing, but voice to text sucks, I know. So I found this thing called Whisper Flow, and it actually puts your words into perfectly edited text, so you won't need to retype anything. I'm not kidding when I say that I saved 10 hours last week on this trick alone. It's called Whisper Flow, thank me later.

summary: The presenter shares a productivity hack to save time by speaking instead of typing. She promotes Whisper Flow, an AI tool that converts voice to perfectly edited text, claiming it saved her 10 hours in a week.
